label_schema.description: BIO tagging scheme for Thai commercial NER (quantity, unit, budget extraction)

labels.name: B-QTY
labels.description: Beginning of quantity (e.g. 50, ร้อย, สอง)

labels.name: B-UNIT
labels.description: Beginning of unit (e.g. กระปุก, ชิ้น, กล่อง, โหล)

labels.name: B-BUDGET
labels.description: Beginning of budget/price (e.g. 2,000, สี่พัน)

labels.name: I-BUDGET
labels.description: Inside of budget (e.g. บาท, THB following a number)

notes: Comma-separated numbers are treated as one token (e.g. '2,000' → single B-BUDGET token)
Currency word following a number (e.g. 'บาท') carries I-BUDGET if it belongs to the same span
Spoken-form numbers (e.g. 'ร้อย', 'สองพัน') are tagged the same as numeric tokens
Typo variants (e.g. 'กรปุก', 'กะปุก') must also be annotated correctly
